newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine cash wheat slips in harvest trade.
newsitem.headline: Argentine cash wheat slips in harvest trade.

text.p: Argentine wheat closed down in moderate volume cash market trade at Buenos Aires Cereals Exchange, with plentiful harvest supply nudging bids down, traders said.

Prices paid to farmers for spot Bahia Blanca wheat shed $1 to $132. April maize was steady in middling turnover at $98. Bids were held firm despite weaker Chicago prices by nerves over Rio Cuarto disease in some crop areas. May soybeans were steady at $250 in moderate volume trade. There was some concern over dryness in central northern Santa Fe province. March sunflower seed lost $2 to $213 in slow trading.
